environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.19 service mesh. The resource-manager deployment has sidecar injection enabled (istio-injection=enabled label on namespace). An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied with spec.action=DENY matching source.namespaces not equal to 'production', combined with a PeerAuthentication policy requiring STRICT mTLS. Additionally, a RequestAuthentication policy validates JWT tokens with issuer bound to the production namespace service account. The DENY policy uses a 'notNamespaces' selector under source, which means the cross-namespace fetch in transferResource to resource-manager.{targetNamespace}.svc.cluster.local will be rejected by the remote sidecar's authorization check when targetNamespace differs from 'production'. However, the local release() call still executes before the network call fails.
